name: JK to Eroriman 2 ~Meikko JK o Mou Hitori Loveho ni Tsurekonde, Sara ni Yaritai Houdai~
original_name: JKとエロリーマン2～姪っ子JKをもう一人ラブホに連れ込んで、さらにヤリたい放題～
source:
The protagonist is a middle-aged, single salaryman.
He’s been having secret hotel dates with his niece, Mifuyu.
Once, after parting ways with Mifuyu, he’s ambushed by another niece, Mana.
"Give Mifuyu back!"
Mana had heard from her mother (the protagonist’s sister) that her uncle was a "hopeless loser," so she couldn’t understand why Mifuyu liked him.
If Mana were left unchecked, his and Mifuyu's relationship would be known to the entire family. Mifuyu tried to reason with her, but Mana wouldn’t listen.
At her wit’s end, Mifuyu came up with a last-ditch plan.
"Alright, then… how about the three of us go to a hotel together?"
Will this mark the end of the protagonist’s love life with Mifuyu?
What will become of the three of them?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120521194557/http://221.245.251.42/soft/bg_712/indexpage.html#stor]the official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名未婚的中年上班族。
他一直偷偷与外甥女野野村美冬在情侣酒店约会。
某次与美冬分开后，另一名外甥女出水爱菜突然拦住了他。
“把美冬还给我！”
爱菜曾听母亲说过，自己的舅舅是个“无可救药的废物”，所以无法理解美冬为何会喜欢他。
若放任爱菜不管，他与美冬的关系就会暴露给全家。美冬试图劝说她，爱菜却不肯听。
走投无路的美冬想出了最后一招。
“好吧，那么……我们三个人一起去酒店怎么样？”
这会为主人公与美冬的恋情画上句号吗？
三人最终会走向怎样的结局？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120521194557/http://221.245.251.42/soft/bg_712/indexpage.html#stor]官方网站[/url]]
